title: Max Stack
description: Design a Max Stack that supports push, pop, top, peekMax, and popMax.
pseudocode:
1. push(x): stack.push(x), maxStack.push(max(x, maxStack.top))
2. pop(): stack.pop(), maxStack.pop()
3. top(): return stack.top()
4. peekMax(): return maxStack.top()
5. popMax(): val = peekMax(), temp = []
6. while stack.top() != val: temp.push(stack.pop()), maxStack.pop()
7. stack.pop(), maxStack.pop()
8. while temp: push(temp.pop())
